entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I'm calling about my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I got it about a month ago, and it's just not working anymore.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's definitely a technical fault. It worked fine for a few weeks, but now it just won't sync with the app at all. I've tried everything. I think the unit is defective.
I see. And you're saying the device seems broken because it won't connect?
That's right. I've charged it, reinstalled the app, tried to re-pair it... nothing. So, I'd like to return it. What are my options? Can I get a partial credit at least?
Let me just pull up your order information. One moment... Okay, I see you received the VeloBand 35 days ago. Let me check our policy for you.
Alright, I've got it here. Our knowledge base shows that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery, as long as they are in the original condition.
Oh, 90 days? That's great. So since it's defective, a full refund is possible?

Yes, absolutely. Since you're well within that 90-day window, I can go ahead and process a full return for you right now. No need to worry about partial credit. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label immediately.
Wow, that was much easier than I expected. Thank you, Alex. I appreciate you making that simple.
You're very welcome. Glad I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
